title: Molecular engineering of residual lithium compounds for stable LiNi0.92Co0.05Mn0.03O2 cathodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6154-6167
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00282F, Paper
Weihong Jiang, Xianshu Wang, Xuerui Yang, Yun Zhao, Jun Yao, Xiaoping Yang, Wei Luo, Liang Luo, Jianguo Duan, Peng Dong, Yingjie Zhang, Baohua Li, Ding Wang
Rationally-designed 2,5-thiophenediylbisboronic acid reacts with residual lithium compounds, followed by in situ electrochemical conversion, to form a stable cathode electrolyte interface that improves lattice integrity and battery performance.
